entities.summary: The New Zealand Legislative Council was the upper house of the General Assembly of New Zealand from 1853 to 1950. An earlier legislative council existed from 1841 when New Zealand became a colony; it was reconstituted as the upper house of a bicameral legislature when New Zealand became self-governing in 1852, which came into effect in the following year.
